program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: No gear and no repeats in thirty-five minutes: bodyweight strength with a burst or a stretch, or cardio with a lift.
program.about: No equipment and about thirty-five minutes, a new pairing every day. Bodyweight strength days end with a short Tabata or a stretch; jump, HIIT, boxing, core and balance days end with a short bodyweight lift. The main work changes kind and format every time. Level II adds reps and Level III holds every hold longer.
program.split: Every day different · no equipment, 35 minutes, two kinds a day
